messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER -> /incident 1725252525 - Billing metering anomaly detected: emitter lag + delayed emits causing downstream undercount and bursty overage flags. Severity: P2. Affected: token counts for hosted API (eu-west-1). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-emit

alice: ack, I'm looking. seeing spike in consumer lag on `meter-emitter` group.

billing-eng: confirmed - consumer lag ~120k messages on partition 12, offsets stuck, connector shows `CommitFailedException`.

alice: running quick checks -> `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-eu:9092 --describe --group meter-emitter`

alice: output snippet:
```
GROUP           TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG             CONSUMER-ID
meter-emitter   metering-event  12         3456789         3576789         120000          consumer-xyz
```

billing-eng: looks like the consumer instance `consumer-xyz` hit an OOM and restarted repeatedly. retry backoff piled up.

sre_lead: mobility note: if we restart the group too fast we risk duplicate delivery; recommend restart consumer-xyz on host host-eu-12 and enable consumer-side dedupe if possible. Also enable `suppress-overflag-alerts` briefly to avoid noisy customer alerts.

ops-bot: issuing restart -> `ssh host-eu-12 sudo systemctl restart meter-emitter-consumer` :spinner:

ops-bot: restart done, consumer rejoined. lag dropping (observed). :white_check_mark:

billing-eng: starting reconciliation/backfill job now: `backfill-metering --group meter-emitter --from-offset 3456789 --to-latest --dry-run=false` ETA ~20m. progress job id 9876.

product-ops: can we suppress customer overage notifications until reconciliation completes? we should avoid false emails. cc: @sre_night for handoff.

sre_lead: agreed. enabling suppression for 40m. API call:
```
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/flags/suppress-overflags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"scope":"eu-west-1","ttl_mins":40}'
```

ops-bot: suppression enabled (flag id sup-2026-03-02-eu). will auto-expire.

alice: metrics showing tokens emitted into ledger increasing; token-count delta trending back to normal within 6 minutes.

billing-eng: backfill job progress: 23% processed (consumer offsets catching up), ETA 15m. logs show occasional `CommitFailedException` recovered.

product-ops: preparing customer note draft: "We observed delayed usage reporting for a subset of API calls in eu-west-1 between 22:10-22:50 UTC. No billing impact expected after reconciliation. We'll follow up if any adjustments needed."

alice: handing over to night oncall @sre_night. summary: consumer OOM -> restart -> backfill started -> suppression active -> monitor reconciliation and postmortem.

sre_night: taking. I'll watch job 9876 and validate final reconciled counts vs shadow ledger. ping if counts don't converge within 40m.

billing-eng: backfill complete. reconciled. final delta within acceptable tolerance (<0.05%). turning off suppression early. :white_check_mark:

product-ops: customer note sent to impacted accounts. no billing adjustments required.

sre_night: thanks all — creating incident ticket and assigning to billing-eng for RCA. closing pager. :lock_with_key:
